steps.caption: Open Deal toolkit.
Start here: every tool — compare, cost a lease, stay or move, negotiation, packs and more.
Needs information: analyses that are waiting on missing inputs — shown, never guessed.
Requirements awaiting analysis, and your recently updated work.
Choose Compare buildings.
Start a new comparison.
Step 1: the requirement and how buildings are rated.
Name it.
Pick the client requirement. Its size and location become the must-have rules.
Rating model sets what matters most; lease term is used for the cost maths.
Step 2: buildings from your database, with micro-market and grade.
Tick the buildings to compare: two in Kharadi, one in Hinjewadi.
Step 3 (optional): add buildings not yet in the database, with rent, CAM, deposit and where the figures came from.
Press Compare buildings.
The recommendation, with the reasons in plain words.
Hinjewadi is 'not eligible': it fails the must-have rule 'in Kharadi'.
The table scores each building on each criterion.
Missing inputs are listed, never treated as zero.
Costs are computed by fixed formulas, not by the AI.
Download deck makes a PowerPoint you can edit and send.
The comparison is saved in Deal toolkit under Recently updated.
